types.name: Angles in triangles and lines
types.description: Finds an angle using the triangle angle sum, an exterior angle, parallel lines with a transversal, or where angle bisectors, altitudes or extended sides meet inside or outside a triangle.

types.name: Congruence, similarity and proportion
types.description: Uses congruence rules (SSS, SAS, ASA, RHS), similar triangles, the basic proportionality theorem, the midpoint theorem, the angle bisector theorem, or ratios of sides, perimeters and areas of triangles.

types.name: Triangle centres and medians
types.description: Involves the centroid, incentre, circumcentre or orthocentre of a triangle, medians and their 2 : 1 split, inradius or circumradius, tangent lengths of an incircle, or angles like ∠BIC and ∠BOC.

types.name: Pythagoras and special triangles
types.description: Uses Pythagoras, Pythagorean triplets, the altitude on the hypotenuse, testing whether a triangle is acute, right or obtuse, or the side ratios of 30-60-90, 45-45-90 and equilateral triangles.

types.name: Chords and angles in circles
types.description: Asks about a chord and its distance from the centre, equal or common chords, angles at the centre or on the circle, the angle in a semicircle, or angles of a cyclic quadrilateral.

types.name: Tangents and secants
types.description: Involves a tangent to a circle: tangent length from an external point, two tangents from a point, the alternate segment theorem, tangent–secant or intersecting chord products, or direct and transverse common tangents of two circles.

types.name: Quadrilaterals
types.description: Asks about angles, sides or diagonals of a parallelogram, rectangle, rhombus, square, trapezium or kite, or a general quadrilateral whose angle bisectors meet.

types.name: Regular polygons
types.description: Asks about the interior or exterior angle, number of sides, sum of angles, or number of diagonals of a polygon, usually a regular one.
